label: TP
reason: Both alerts are TP. Alert 1 (xss): User input flows through escapeHtml() to response.getWriter().format(bar,obj) - while escapeHtml() encodes HTML entities, the format() call is an unreliable sink for HTML output and may not preserve encoding. Alert 2 (tainted-format-string): CRITICAL - bar (containing user input) is passed directly as a format string argument to response.getWriter().format(), enabling format string attacks (%n, %x, %d specifiers) that bypass any prior encoding. Resolved sink value for Alert 2: bar = escapeHtml(user_input) - attacker-controlled data reaches format string sink.

evidence.note: User input from getParameterValues flows through escapeHtml() to response.getWriter().format(bar,obj) - format string sink enables format string attacks
